_comment: Edit with switchboard.py (add/remove/list), or by hand. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, in/out, recorded when the entry was added — they drift, so treat them as ordering, not billing. 'good_at' is fed verbatim to the router model when Auto picks.
_providers_note: A vendor with its own Anthropic-compatible endpoint and its own subscription, matched on the first segment of the model id. path_prefix is joined to the incoming path, so /coding + /v1/messages -> /coding/v1/messages. The key file is read per request and never cached; your claude.ai token is stripped before the request leaves the machine. Set cache_control false if a vendor rejects the markers, and add to drop_fields anything it 400s on.
_picker_note: Gateway rows are published after the six built-in Claude rows. Order this list by how often each is picked by hand — Auto is always first. openrouter/auto is deliberately NOT listed: it is a delegation target for Auto (rule 4), not a hand-pick. Picking it directly can never select a subscription model, so every turn costs cash — the inverse of what Auto is for. Launch with --model openrouter/auto if it is ever wanted explicitly.
_lineup_note: Used by 'picker --apply': the WHOLE /model menu, in order, weighted by how likely each is to be picked by hand. Ten rows is the limit before Claude Code collapses the rest behind '… +N models'. A row with only a 'model' key fills its label and description from the catalog (blurb + price); give label/description explicitly for Claude ids, which are not catalog entries. Anything left out is still routable by Auto.

models.name: Claude Haiku

models.blurb: Quick answers and light tool use

models.name: Kimi K3 (sub)
models.good_at: building user interfaces - React, CSS, layout, data visualisation, marketing pages. Costs no cash. Consumes the SEPARATE Kimi subscription quota, not Claude quota, so sending work here preserves Claude quota rather than spending it.
models.source: Arena WebDev #1 (1679) Jul 2026; Vercel Next.js eval tied #1 at 92%

models.name: Kimi K3
models.good_at: same model as kimi/k3 but billed per token through OpenRouter. Only worth picking as overflow, when the Kimi subscription's rate-limit window is exhausted. building user interfaces - React, CSS, layout, data visualisation, marketing pages
models.source: Arena WebDev #1 (1679) Jul 2026; Vercel Next.js eval tied #1 at 92%

models.name: OpenRouter Auto
models.good_at: ANY paid work with no specialist need. Delegates the choice: OpenRouter classifies the prompt into a task type and ranks models by community spend over 7 days, so it tracks the field without this catalog being maintained. Prefer it over naming a specific priced model unless that model has a SPECIALTY the task needs.
models.source: openrouter.ai auto router; ranks by trailing-7-day community task spend

_arrow_note: The ←/→ row. Claude Code's effort slider reaches the wire as output_config.effort, and a row declared via ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION with SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES=effort,xhigh_effort,max_effort gets that slider even as a gateway id. So one picker row carries this shortlist and the arrows choose between them. Ordered weakest to strongest; an unmapped level falls to the strongest set.
